methodology: Small authored fictional DEVELOPMENT set. Corpus/questions frozen before first run; index context and blend chosen using these results. Not a held-out or general benchmark. No fine-tuning or query-specific rules. Evaluation questions are never inserted into the index. TF-IDF baseline uses the same contextualized source text as the hybrid model.

model.name: MiniLM + TF-IDF · local CPU
model.description: 384-dimensional MiniLM embeddings with source title/byline context. Ranking blends 50% semantic cosine with 50% TF-IDF. Displayed similarity is neural cosine, not the blended rank or confidence. Answers are verbatim excerpts.

limitations: A related passage is not necessarily an answer.
Similarity is not probability or truth.
In-domain missing facts can retrieve strongly related text instead of abstaining.
Conflict flags are manually catalogued, not automatically inferred.
Synthetic corpus and authored tests are small and not independently validated.
